task.output: One short summary and one suggested referral per note, for a person to check
task.schedule: Recurring: once a week, when you start it. It never starts by itself.
task.title: Run: summarize and sort this week's case notes

task_object.description: A process your own agent runs on your own computers. It reads scanned handwritten case notes, writes a short plain-language summary of each and suggests a referral partner from your own published list. A person checks every summary and makes every referral.
holds: Instructions: what the agent does, step by step, and what it must refuse
Skills: read handwriting, summarize a note, suggest a referral partner
Checks and made-up test cases that prove it works
how_to: Scan or photograph this week's notes into one folder on your own computer.
Start the task below with your own agent. It reads only that folder.
Check each summary and suggested referral. A person decides every referral.
install: Use an agent you already trust, such as a coding agent on your computer or a container your IT team runs.
Copy the process folder: its instructions, skills, checks and made-up test cases.
Run the checks once on the made-up test cases before you use real notes.
task_object.title: Read, summarize and sort handwritten case notes
